title: echinochloa crus-galli subsp. submutica
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli subsp. submutica, commonly known as the Japanese barnyard grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Echinochloa crus-galli subsp. submutica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
